name: Custard
description: Milk thickened with egg yolk or powder — poured hot, or set cold.

ayurveda.note: Anda is ushna over a shita milk base.

histamine.note: Egg is a liberator; the powdered versions are mostly cornflour and colour.

guna.note: Fresh dairy is sattvic; the reading changes once it sours or ages.
